blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Both support vaginal health and women’…
blocks_element.text:
Both support vaginal health and women’s microbiome. Here’s how they differ:

Format: Gummies are Pink Pineapple flavored, while capsules are flavorless.

CFU count: Capsules contain 5B CFU, while gummies contain 1B CFU.

Probiotic strains: Capsules contain multiple Lactobacillus probiotic strains, while gummies are formulated with a clinical dose of SNZ 1969®.

Additional ingredients: Gummies include Vitamins C and D for added women’s health support, while capsules contain XOS prebiotics to support the probiotics.*

Both products support vaginal health and women’s microbiome balance. Capsules also support vaginal odor, vaginal pH, vaginal flora, and yeast balance.*

Still not sure which is right for you? Both formats are safe to take together. If you prefer a capsule with a broader probiotic blend, choose URO Vaginal Probiotic Capsules. If you prefer a great-tasting gummy with added vitamins, URO Vaginal Probiotic Gummies are for you.
